declarations.review_basis: Root accepted the independent repaired-source review and exact-wrapper CPU metadata probe. For natural dimensions and distinct logical input/output regions, logical allocation initializes arbitrary sampled fp16 words and zero output, then executes the complete original typed kernel once with fresh registers and program id zero. The independent flat transpose reference covers every output bit, preserves allocated inputs and frames all cells outside the two allocation slices. Output injectivity is proved. Empty-shape contiguous strides use max(dim,1), with simplification justified by actual Fin indices. The result includes equal shape products; the shape/stride helpers are ghost metadata, not a returned native Tensor theorem. Nat parameters, logical allocation and total execution do not classify Python caller/error paths or native zero/non-power-of-two arange rejection, prove CUDA allocation/launch, establish complete native shape/resource admission, or bind physical storage/ABI. signed32_offset_bounds concerns final logical element offsets only. Arbitrary raw fp16 payloads require no RNG distribution law or floating numerical callback; no numerical assumption is added.

Cover Python caller types and negative dimensions, tensor allocator failure/CUDA availability, and all original host-error exits; Input Nat omits these.
Bind returned tensor shape/stride/storage metadata and logical allocation regions to actual wrapper/native allocation behavior.
Establish complete native arange/tile admissibility beyond power-of-two necessity, runtime stride/index width, physical byte addressing, ABI, lowering and device execution correspondence.

declarations.review_basis: Producer proposal awaiting independent root review. Existing actual fp16 six-statement interpreter is composed with exact source-ordered arange/broadcast admission and the wrapper allocation/launch/return wiring under explicit trusted primitive contracts. Every admitted shape is retained: 231 pairs m=2^a,d=2^b,a+b<=20. The admission theorem covers the entire natural-shape complement using nine first-failure partitions. Ordinary errors are propagated at randn, zeros, launch setup, or post-frontend backend/runtime; no arbitrary successful-run or final-value oracle is used. Returned metadata, all fp16 payloads, all output cells, input preservation and full memory frame are included. There is no floating arithmetic callback or numerical deferral.
